messages:
alex: Quick sync — we need a facilitator for the post-incident review for the Canopy storage latency incident last night. Incident archived by the bot but we still need a PIR to capture action items and follow-ups. Proposed window: Thu 2025-09-11 15:00 UTC (60m). Who can take facilitator?

maya: I can do facilitation if no one else is available. I've run a couple of these and can keep it tight. Will need a scribe.

jordan: Thanks Maya — appreciate it. I'm happy to scribe. Can we do 14:00 UTC instead? I have a customer call at 15.

alex: 14:00 UTC works for me. Anyone in APAC who needs to join? Sasha?

sasha: 14:00 UTC is 23:00 for me, can join briefly for the RCA section but can't stay the whole hour. If you need full coverage maybe ask Eli to fill APAC slot.

eli: I can cover APAC. 14:00 UTC is okay. I'll pick up any follow-ups that touch Dedicated infra.

zoe: FYI PM-side: we'll want product impact notes in the PIR and a list of affected customers. I can prepare the customer-impact summary doc beforehand.

incident-bot: Incident RW-2025-09-10-Canopy-Latency archived by @oncall-bot. Summary: transient KV-store latency spike, ~5m escalated errors for 2% of requests, automatic fallback executed. Postmortem requested.

oncall-bot: Paging log and timeline uploaded: https://storage.redwood.example/pir/RW-2025-09-10-canopy/timeline.log

alex: Great — Maya facilitator, Jordan scribe, Eli APAC coverage, Zoe customer notes. Action items before PIR: 1) Compile timeline & alerts (eng-oncall) 2) Perf graphs and slow traces (runtime/infra) 3) Customer impact list (product) 4) Draft remediation proposals (services)

maya: I'll send a calendar invite in a minute. Please add the pre-read to the event. Pre-read checklist: timeline, one-page impact, initial root-cause hypotheses, proposed mitigations.

jordan: I created the PIR doc draft and added an agenda + a place to capture action items: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1PirDraftRW (internal) — I'll paste perf graphs when infra has them.

eli: Jotted two proposed mitigations in the doc: increase prefix cache size, and add a short-circuit path for cold KV reads. I'll attach microbenchmark results.

alex: Also let's decide facilitator rules up front: timebox RCA to 20m, avoid deep design in the PIR — create follow-up working sessions for remediation engineering. Maya, can you enforce? :slightly_smiling_face:

maya: Yep — I'll enforce. Also prefer we assign owners for every action item during the PIR and set tentative due dates.

sasha: Quick ask — can we include a brief customer comms draft? If we need to notify any customers proactively. Zoe — could you prepare a short e-mail template?

zoe: On it. Draft will include impacted time window, symptoms, mitigation already applied, and ETA for permanent fix.

alex: Scheduling note: I'm adding a canary/ops attendee list. Please ping folks who were paged: @infra-leads, @runtime, @sre.

jordan: Also adding the incident runbook link and the oncall transcript in the doc: `#oncall-transcript` section.

maya: Invite sent: Thu 2025-09-11 14:00 UTC, 60m. Guests: alex, maya, jordan, sasha, eli, zoe, runtime-oncall, infra-lead. Calendar link: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=RW-Canopy-PIR (internal)

alex: Perfect. One more ask — let's assign a follow-up owner to validate the KV-store patch (if chosen) and one for observability gaps.

eli: I volunteer for KV patch owner.

jordan: I'll take observability gaps and file a tracking ticket. Ticket: RW-1234 (will create during PIR).

maya: Great — closing notes: facilitator = maya, scribe = jordan, owners: eli (KV patch), jordan (observability), zoe (customer comms). Please add any other folks to the invite who were paged last night. I'll run a 10-minute pre-read sync 30m before the PIR for any clarifying Qs.

alex: Thanks everyone. If there are no objections I'll mark the PIR scheduled and create the postmortem tracking card. :thumbsup:

oncall-bot: Reminder set for pre-read sync at 2025-09-11T13:30:00Z.

incident-bot: PIR card: https://tracker.redwood.example/board/RW-PIRs/Canopy-2025-09-10
